verified_facts: OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid with OS Net stations
OSTN15 transformation accuracy is distinct from GNSS positional error
OSTN15 is treated by OS as effectively error-free for its own transformation component
agreement with old triangulation stations is about 0.1m rms in Great Britain
OS Net station plan-coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008m
OS Net station height standard errors are generally better than 0.020m
horizontal transformation error must be separated from terrain vertical RMSE
candidate coordinates must preserve whether they are native BNG or transformed
quality_effect: Separates horizontal coordinate transformation uncertainty from vertical terrain-surface uncertainty.
